description: Thickens a manifold sheet body along its normal direction by a specified distance range that includes the base surface, producing one or more solid result bodies.

topotrack.reason: Adapter records ModelingRet status and captures topology tracking as status/topocheck artifacts only; full topology diff is not required for this archetype.

notes: Input must be a manifold sheet body; thickening interval must include 0 (the base surface) for the SDK to find lateral edges successfully.
The defaulted ThickenOpts parameter is omitted so the SDK default is used.
